about: Krish's taste graph. Tracks from his Spotify playlist 'Chillout & Ambient' (99 tracks, read 2026-11-13). Release year and label come from Spotify pages; tempo, key, frequency balance, dynamics and stems are measured by trackcard on each track's Spotify preview clip (15-30 s), so they describe a slice, not the whole track. Style families are inferred.

nodes.name: German and Euro melodic deep house
nodes.description: Warm, patient, melodic 4/4 at 118-124 BPM: long builds, emotive leads, deep subs. Berlin and the Stil vor Talent / Suol orbit.

nodes.name: Sunny deep house with a song in it
nodes.description: The 2013-15 crossover sound: a folk or pop vocal, sax, marimba or plucked hook over a soft deep-house groove. Bright, major, warm.

nodes.name: UK and soulful vocal house
nodes.description: Garage swing, diva or soul vocals, organs and chunky basslines; disco and nu-disco edges.

nodes.name: Downtempo, trip-hop and global fusion
nodes.description: Under or around 100 BPM, or swung: breakbeats, live instruments, world and Latin elements, electro-swing, cinematic chill.
